highlights.text: Architected and delivered a multi-tenant enterprise CRM from scratch across five modules — lead management, KPI tracking, project management, attendance, and payroll — deployed to multiple enterprise client accounts.
Designed the tenancy model so isolation is enforced at the database layer rather than in application code, making cross-tenant data access structurally impossible instead of merely unlikely.
Built Courier Hub, an e-commerce logistics platform handling order processing, invoicing, and multi-account shipping integration with built-in reporting.
Moved slow synchronous work onto BullMQ and Redis, improving perceived system responsiveness by roughly 40%, and automated recurring SEO content workflows with n8n.
Provisioned and operated the AWS footprint — EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, Amplify — behind Nginx, and implemented RAG retrieval over Pinecone and pgvector for semantic search.
